resources.string: Pinch below to change the app layout on the Glasses.
Pinch to adjust projected app scale
Opening the app on the Glasses…
Scale requested. The number shows the latest observed layout.
Applied scale from the projected display.
Layout changed or rotated. Pinch again to adjust.
That scale is outside the display’s supported dimensions. Pinch back toward the current scale.
This app or display cannot apply the requested scale.
Scale requested, but the preference could not be saved. Try again.
The app could not be confirmed on the projection display. Return to Phone controls and choose it again.
The projected app changed. Return to Phone controls and choose Scale for the app again.
Scale is unavailable. Return to Phone controls, check the connection and choose Scale again.
